exposure: surfactant use in the first 72 hours of life
surfactant use in the delivery room
number of surfactant doses (2 or more doses)
cohort: A cohort of 971 preterm infants diagnosed with bronchopulmonary dysplasia.
finding: Surfactant use, specifically in the delivery room or multiple doses, was associated with a greater likelihood of grade 3 bronchopulmonary dysplasia in preterm infants.
